$comment: The Architect's revision of La Fabrique's architecture for folder-lint-specification.json, as a person would post it: the next version of the company's one architecture (follow-up 3 of docs/retrospectives/2026-11-self-hosting.md). scripts/self_host/self_host.py --spec opens it with POST /v1/companies/{id}/architecture/revisions, which keeps each module's covers of the earlier specifications under earlier_covers, writes the covers below for this specification's requirements, appends the interface and approves it. No decision is added: the change follows ADR-7's interfaces and the stack profile per folder already in the record.
title: La Fabrique backend, revised for the lint per folder

interfaces.name: Folder lint command
interfaces.contract:
Company.stack_profile["folders"][<folder>] = {"stack", "install", "test", "lint"}; stack_roots.resolve_folders(...) -> [{"folder", "stack", "manifests", "install", "test", "lint", "source"}]
edit_lint.load_profile(bridge, company_id, root, engine) -> the root's resolved profile with "folders": the resolved folders
edit_lint.after_edit runs stack_roots.in_folder(<folder lint narrowed to the file>, <folder>) for a file under a folder; extra["lint"]["folder"] names it
